QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Please Check on Her
QuestInfo.0: Android #b#p2154007##k at the #m310050400# in the Mine has a favor to ask. Talk to #p2154007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154007# is worried about his sister deep inside the cave. He wants you to deliver an Energy Cartridge to #bhis sister#k. First, talk to #p2154007#'s sister...she can be found past #m310060000#.
QuestInfo.2: You met #p2154007#'s sister, #p2154012#. She has even less feelings and emotions than #p2154007#!

0.0: Judging by the current location, your outfit, and your level, and also by simply looking at your face, I conclude that you are #h0#. I also conclude that you have much time on your hands. Therefore I will entrust a personal mission to you.

yes.0: You can reach #m310060000# by going deeper into the mine shaft. You will find my #bsister Dolcetta-2000#k there. Please deliver this spare Energy Cartridge to her. I have a feeling that she is not receiving sufficient energy.
yes.1: Of course #o8105003# enemies have siblings. We consider others with similar basic structures who were created at roughly the same time to be our siblings. I am a male version of the model. My sister is the female version. We also have an older sister, Muscat-2000. Now, please deliver this cartridge for me.

no.0: Based on our past interactions, I had not expected such an answer from you. My calculations showed a 97.4% chance of you agreeing to my proposition.

1.0: Do not initiate prohibited conversation. What can I do for you? This item is an NE-02. My assessment is that it is one of #p2154007#'s spare Energy Cartridges. Explain why you are giving this to me.

yes.0: #p2154007# asked you to bring this to me? Very well. Consider it delivered.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #bsister#k yet? She is in a deeper cave past the #m310060000#. Follow the mine shaft.
